name: Dry dog food
definition: complete dry kibble food made for dogs.

name: Wet dog food
definition: complete canned or pouched moist food made for dogs.

name: Fresh or frozen dog food
definition: chilled or frozen prepared or raw food made for dogs.

name: Freeze-dried or air-dried dog food
definition: dehydrated raw or cooked food made for dogs.

name: Veterinary dog food
definition: food formulated for a dog's health need and sold as a diet beside dry and wet.

name: Dog treat
definition: a reward or snack for dogs that is not a complete food.

name: Dog crate
definition: a box or cage in which a dog is kept or transported at home.

name: Dog kennel
definition: an outdoor house for a dog.

name: Dog bed
definition: a bed, cushion or basket made for a dog to sleep on.

name: Dog collar
definition: a band worn round a dog's neck.

name: Dog lead
definition: a line used to hold or walk a dog.

name: Dog harness
definition: straps worn round a dog's body to hold or walk it.

name: Dog coat
definition: a garment made to be worn by a dog.

name: Dog toy
definition: an object made for a dog to chew, fetch, tug or play with.

name: Dog agility equipment
definition: obstacles and gear for dog sport and training.

name: Dry cat food
definition: complete dry kibble food made for cats.

name: Cat tree
definition: a free-standing or pole-fixed climbing and resting structure made for cats.

name: Cat litter
definition: absorbent material made for a cat's toilet.

name: Small-animal food
definition: food made for rabbits, guinea pigs, hamsters and other small mammals.

name: Small-animal cage or hutch
definition: a cage, habitat or hutch in which a small mammal is housed.

name: English saddle
definition: a saddle of the English riding tradition.

name: Western saddle
definition: a saddle of the Western riding tradition.

name: Saddle pad
definition: a pad worn under a saddle.

name: Bridle
definition: headgear with reins by which a horse is steered.

name: Snaffle bit
definition: a direct-pressure bit.

name: Curb bit
definition: a leverage bit.

name: Bitless bridle
definition: headgear that steers without a mouthpiece.

name: Headcollar
definition: headgear used to lead or tie a horse.

name: Turnout rug
definition: a waterproof rug (blanket) worn by a horse outdoors.

name: Stable rug
definition: a rug (blanket) worn by a horse indoors.

name: Fly mask
definition: a mesh mask worn over a horse's face against flies.

name: Tendon boot
definition: a protective boot worn on a horse's leg.

name: Horse grooming brush
definition: a brush made for grooming a horse.

name: Fish food
definition: food made for aquarium or pond fish.

name: Aquarium
definition: a glass or acrylic tank in which fish are kept.

name: Canister filter
definition: an external filter in a closed canister fed by hoses.

name: Hang-on-back filter
definition: a filter hung on the rear of the tank.

name: Internal filter
definition: a filter placed inside the tank.

name: Aquarium sump
definition: a separate tank below the aquarium that holds filtration.

name: Under-gravel filter
definition: a filter plate laid under the gravel.

name: Aquarium heater
definition: a heater that warms aquarium water.

name: Aquarium light
definition: a lamp or light unit made for an aquarium.

name: Aquarium substrate
definition: gravel, sand or other bed material for the tank floor.

name: Aquarium decoration
definition: ornaments, rock, wood and other furnishings for a tank.

name: Water test kit
definition: a kit that tests aquarium water.

name: Reptile food
definition: prepared food made for reptiles and amphibians.

name: Frozen feeder animal
definition: A dead frozen animal sold as food for reptiles; live feeders are not included.

name: Vivarium
definition: an empty enclosure in which reptiles or amphibians are kept.

name: Basking lamp
definition: a lamp that gives a reptile a heated basking spot.

name: Ceramic heat emitter
definition: a heat source that gives heat without light.

name: Deep heat projector
definition: a heat source that projects infrared heat.

name: Reptile heat mat
definition: a heating pad fitted on or against the enclosure.

name: Reptile thermostat
definition: a control that regulates enclosure heat.

name: UVB lamp
definition: a lamp that gives ultraviolet B light to a reptile.

name: Reptile substrate
definition: floor material for a reptile enclosure.

name: Reptile hide
definition: a shelter in which a reptile hides.

name: Wild bird seed
definition: seed or seed mix made for wild birds.

name: Suet or fat ball
definition: a fat-based wild bird food.

name: Tube feeder
definition: a hanging seed tube with ports.

name: Hopper feeder
definition: a seed feeder with a hopper and a tray.

name: Suet feeder
definition: a feeder that holds suet blocks or cakes.

name: Nyjer feeder
definition: a feeder made for fine nyjer seed.

name: Peanut mesh feeder
definition: a steel-mesh feeder for peanuts.

name: Ground feeder
definition: a feeder or tray set at ground level.

name: Bird feeding station
definition: a stand or table carrying several feeders.

name: Wild bird nest box
definition: a box made for wild birds to nest in.

name: Bird bath
definition: a basin that gives wild birds water to drink and bathe in.

name: Bee feeder
definition: a device that gives bees syrup or other feed.

name: Framed vertical hive
definition: a hive that grows upward with frames in stacked boxes.

name: Long hive
definition: a horizontal frame hive.

name: Top-bar hive
definition: a hive whose combs hang from bars.

name: Warre hive
definition: a vertical hive that grows downward with bars in stacked boxes.

name: Bee smoker
definition: a tool that blows smoke to calm bees.

name: Honey extractor
definition: a machine that spins honey from combs.

name: Uncapping knife or fork
definition: a tool that removes wax cappings from combs.

name: Honey bottling bucket or tank
definition: a bucket or tank that holds honey for bottling.

name: Poultry starter feed
definition: complete feed for chicks.

name: Poultry grower feed
definition: complete feed for growing birds.

name: Poultry layer feed
definition: complete feed for laying hens.

name: Scratch grain
definition: a grain mix fed to poultry as a supplement.

name: Poultry feeder or waterer
definition: a feeder or drinker made for poultry.

name: Chicken coop
definition: a house for backyard hens.

name: Small egg incubator
definition: a small egg incubator for pet or backyard use; commercial hatchers are not here.

name: Hay
definition: dried grass fed to horses, small mammals and other animals.

name: Pet food and water bowl
definition: a bowl or dish for food or water, made for more than one animal group.

name: Pet gate
definition: a gate sold only for pets.

name: Pet pen
definition: a pen sold only for pets.

name: Pet camera
definition: a camera sold only for pets.

name: Pet carrier
definition: a carrier that holds an animal and is not a vehicle.

name: Flea, tick and worm treatment
definition: a medicine against parasites in pets.

name: Pet ID tag
definition: a tag worn by a pet that carries its identity.

name: Identification microchip
definition: an implanted chip that identifies an animal.

name: Microchip scanner
definition: a reader of pet identification microchips.

name: GPS pet tracker
definition: a device that tracks a pet's location by GPS.

name: Hive body
definition: a box of a hive.

name: Hive frame
definition: a hive frame that carries comb.

name: Horse girth
definition: a strap that holds a saddle on a horse.

name: Aquarium filter media
definition: filter material made for one aquarium filter.

name: Dog muzzle
definition: a basket, cage or strap fitted over a dog's muzzle to stop it biting or scavenging.

name: Dog waste bag
definition: a bag made for picking up and disposing of a dog's droppings.

name: Pet door
definition: a flap or small door fitted in a door, wall or window that lets a cat or small dog pass in and out.

name: Cat scratcher
definition: a post, pad or board of sisal, cardboard or carpet made for a cat to scratch.

name: Saddle stirrup
definition: a foot rest hung from a saddle for the rider, with or without its leather.

name: Martingale
definition: a strap or straps from the girth to the reins or noseband that limit how high a horse carries its head.

name: Cooler rug
definition: a wicking rug worn by a horse to dry and cool off after work or washing.

name: Fly rug
definition: a light mesh rug (fly sheet) worn by a horse against flies.

name: Overreach boot
definition: a bell-shaped boot (bell boot) worn round a horse's pastern to protect heel and coronet.

name: Curry comb
definition: a rubber, plastic or metal comb with rows of teeth used to loosen dirt and hair from a horse's coat.

name: Lunge line
definition: a long line fixed to a horse's headgear by which it is worked in a circle round the handler.

name: Australian stock saddle
definition: a saddle of the Australian stock-riding tradition, with knee pads (poleys) and a deep seat.

name: Pack saddle
definition: a frame saddle that carries a load, not a rider, on a pack animal.

name: Aquarium air pump
definition: a pump that blows air into an aquarium through a line and air stone.

name: Aquarium water treatment
definition: a liquid or additive that conditions aquarium water (dechlorinator, bacterial starter, clarifier, algae control).

name: Bird cage
definition: a wire cage in which a pet bird is kept.

name: Bird perch
definition: a rod, branch or platform fitted in a cage for a bird to stand on.

name: Bird toy
definition: an object made for a cage bird to chew, forage, climb or play with.

name: Cage-bird feeder or drinker
definition: a cup, dish, hopper or drinker fitted to a bird cage.

name: Cage-bird nest box
definition: a nest box or nest pan fitted to a cage or aviary for breeding birds.

name: Feeder hook or bracket
definition: a hook, bracket or hanger made to hang one bird feeder.

name: Hummingbird feeder
definition: a feeder with ports that gives nectar or sugar water to hummingbirds.

name: Queen excluder
definition: a grid laid between hive boxes that keeps the queen out of the honey supers.

name: Comb foundation
definition: a wax or plastic sheet embossed with cell bases, fitted in a hive frame.

name: Varroa treatment
definition: a medicine, strip or vapour that controls varroa mites in a honey bee colony.

name: Brooder heating plate
definition: a heated plate on legs under which chicks keep warm.

name: Pet water fountain
definition: a powered bowl that circulates and filters drinking water for pets.

name: Automatic pet feeder
definition: a timed or app-controlled dispenser that releases portions of dry food for pets.

name: Driving harness
definition: the set of harness a horse, pony or donkey wears to draw a vehicle or implement: collar or breastplate, harness saddle, traces, breeching and reins.

name: Electronic pet fence
definition: a boundary-wire, wireless or GPS system that keeps a dog or cat inside a set area by signalling a receiver collar it wears.

name: Wet cat food
definition: a moist cat food in a can, pouch or tray.

name: Fresh or frozen cat food
definition: a lightly cooked or raw cat food kept chilled or frozen.

name: Cat treat
definition: a snack fed to a cat apart from its meals; complementary, not a complete diet.

name: Compound horse feed
definition: Manufactured concentrate feed for horses: pellets, cubes, coarse mix or muesli. It may be a complete feed or a top-up feed.

name: Hoof care product
definition: an oil, balm, conditioner, packing or poultice applied to a horse's hoof.

name: Horse supplement
definition: a nutritional supplement fed to a horse (joint, hoof, coat, digestive, electrolyte).

name: Hay net
definition: a net or bag of rope or mesh that holds hay for a horse to pull from.

name: Pet supplement
definition: a nutritional supplement for dogs or cats (joint, skin and coat, digestive, calming).

name: Pet shampoo
definition: a shampoo, conditioner, spray or wipe for cleaning a pet's coat and skin.

name: Veterinary cat food
definition: food formulated for a cat's health need and sold as a diet beside dry and wet.

name: Freeze-dried or air-dried cat food
definition: dehydrated raw or cooked food made for cats.

name: Lead rope
definition: a rope or strap with a clip or snap that is fixed to a headcollar to lead or tie up a horse.

name: Horse reins
definition: a pair of straps or a rope fixed to the bit or noseband, by which a rider or driver steers; sold apart from the bridle.

name: Hive tool
definition: a flat steel lever with a scraper or hook end used to prise apart hive boxes and frames.

name: Queen-rearing kit
definition: a cell-cup system (cups, cell plugs, holders and cell bars) sold as one kit to raise queen bees, with or without grafting.

name: Queen cage
definition: a small cage in which a queen bee is introduced, shipped or marked.

name: Grafting tool
definition: a fine spoon, needle or spring tool that lifts young larvae into queen cups.

name: Cage-bird food
definition: Seed mix, pellets, egg food, millet spray or treats made for pet cage and aviary birds. Wild-bird food is under Birds, in Wild bird food.

name: Gag bit
definition: bit whose cheekpieces slide through rings on the mouthpiece so rein pressure raises it in the mouth (elevator or gag action).

name: Wall-mounted cat furniture
definition: shelves, steps, bridges and beds fixed to a wall for a cat to climb and rest on.

name: Platform feeder
definition: open tray feeder raised on a pole, hung or fixed to a feeder, from which birds take seed.

name: Hive frame grip
definition: hand tool that grips the top bar of a hive frame so it can be lifted out of the box.

name: Self-cleaning litter box
definition: powered cat litter box that rakes, sifts or rotates waste into a sealed bin after use.

name: Litter disposal pail
definition: lidded bin that seals used cat litter in a bag or film until it is emptied.
